programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.sub-title: "Lone Star Boating: Exploring Central Texas Lakes & Rivers"
programme.desc: In Episode 10 Boat Trader heads to central Texas to explore boating culture in the lone star state. Second only to Alaska in size, Texas is known as the place where everything is bigger. From big college football games to endless oil fields and vast wind farms, Texas is home to more than 30 million Americans. But the state is about more than just big oil, college football and cattle farms - it's also home to some of the best boating in the country. Boasting a myriad of waterways, boaters here enjoy hundreds of lakes, rivers and streams that provide recreational opportunities, abundant wildlife and plenty of fishing. From Austin Texas to San Antonio host Ryan McVinney and the Boat Trader crew explore the laid-back Texas lake life including boat up restaurants along the Colorado River, watersports in Austin and the history of the waterways throughout the region. Boat manufacturers highlighted in this episode are Tige Boats and ATX Surf Boats, two premium Texas-based wake boat brands known for their high-quality, cutting-edge vessels that come equipped with advanced wake shaping technologies and equipment ideal for water skiing, wake surfing and wakeboarding. There's even a wake surfing dog!

programme.desc: It is Mark Peterson’s third day in Mexico hunting for a Mexican Texanus Whitetail. After bagging two big bucks in just two days with his new Gunwerks Nexus 300 PRC, he is now moving to a new farm where a giant 12-point buck has often been seen in the southeast corner of the property. It’s the coldest day since he arrived, which typically means the deer will be more active. He is thrilled at the prospect of what could be the best day yet. If everything goes well, they will spend the evening - hunting hogs from the high rack.

This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. programme.title: The Journey Within

In pursuit of one of the smallest and rarest Whitetail subspecies, the elusive Mexican Central Plateau Whitetail, Mark faces harsh terrain, high elevations, and the challenge of locating a deer that few hunters have ever seen, let alone taken.

programme.title: 2022 Western Australia Margaret River Pro Finals Day | REPLAY
programme.desc: Margaret River tests survival in raw WA surf as the Mid-season Cut trims the field to 22 men and 10 women.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Surf Abu Dhabi Pro 2025
programme.desc: The WSL Championship Tour makes its groundbreaking debut in the Middle East at the 2025 Surf Abu Dhabi Pro. The second stop on the CT marks professional surfing's continued global expansion and also establishes Abu Dhabi as an official surf destination. Engineered for excellence, this high-performance wave will provide a canvas for the world's best surfers set against a stunning backdrop of the Arabian Gulf. The event will showcase not only the remarkable evolution of professional surfing beyond its traditional roots, but also the infinite possibility for progression from athletes like rookie Erin Brooks, former World Champion Italo Ferreira, and reigning World Champ Caity Simmers.

programme.title: UNBOXING THINGS with Koa Smith
programme.sub-title: WSL | Unboxing Things With Koa Smith

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: 2025 MEO Rip Curl Pro Portugal | Highlights
programme.desc: Relive Supertubos action as elite surfers battle Portugal’s hollow waves for key world title momentum.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: All In | Dealing With Defeat On The WSL World Tour
programme.desc: Coming into the 2019 Quiksilver and Roxy Pros in Hossegor, France, Kanoa Igarashi and Steph Gilmore were looking to post big results — but both fell heartbreakingly short. In this episode of All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour, we go behind the scenes with Kanoa and Steph as they deal with falling short in France — and regrouping for the next event.

programme.title: WSL Competition Highlights
programme.desc: See all the best scores from the WSL surfing season.

programme.title: #TOURNOTES
programme.desc: Take an inside look at the day-to-day of the World Surf League tour.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners
programme.sub-title: Surf Drums | Brilliant Corners: Senegal, Episode 2
programme.desc: Sam, Easkey, and Adrien travel north to Kayar, a city dominated by its busy fishing industry. They learn that surfing has created new work opportunities for the younger generation through teaching and competition. They then dive into the rich culture of Mbalax music, learn about djembe drumming, and discover how its rhythm is similar to that of surfing.

programme.title: Lawn Patrol
programme.sub-title: WSL | Unboxing Things With Koa Smith
programme.desc: Koa Smith takes a look at all the latest surfing gear.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: VIVO Rio Pro presented by Corona Cero 2025
programme.desc: The World Title race is set to supercharge in Saquarema. The passion of Brazil's surf fans, the electric atmosphere of Saquarema, and the pressure of the back half of the season is unmatched. It's loud. It's wild. It's must-watch professional surfing. The World Title chase continues next in Brazil.

programme.title: 2025 Lexus Tahiti Pro Day 1 | REPLAY
programme.desc: More than a Championship Tour event, the Lexus Tahiti Pro presented by I-SEA will be a reckoning on the 2025 World Title race. It's the last chance for surfers looking to clinch their spot in the WSL Final 5, defend their place in the rankings, or even rewrite a season. The beauty of Teahupo'o is how it disguises its brutality. In Tahiti, it's no longer about surviving the season. It’s about earning the right to fight for a World Title.

programme.title: 2023 Billabong Pro Pipeline Finals Day | REPLAY
programme.desc: As the epicenter of the surf universe and the birthplace of the sport, it’s only right for Pipeline to kick off the Championship Tour. Everyone enters the season with equal hopes of winning it all. The rookie class is thrown into the fire, the contenders return with one thing on their minds, and the surf world begins to follow the road to the Rip Curl WSL Finals. Pipeline sets the tone.

programme.desc: Lou hooks up with keyboardist Patric Johnston while Summer records an original song at a legendary recording studio. Phanie learns about the multicultural history of the accordion aka Texas squeezebox.

programme.desc: Phanie gets a lesson in the bajo sexto, a 12-stringed guitar, while Lou meets the owner of Houston’s independent record shop Vinal Edge. Summer tries her hand at graffiti art.

programme.title: Paul & Nick's Big American Food Trip
programme.desc: In the middle of rural Maine, Paul and Nick create an outside barbeque for the family of John Mann, an eighth generation Ulster-Scot immigrant. The Manns are true frontier-people, and completely self sufficient from their land.

programme.title: Paul & Nick's Big American Food Trip
programme.desc: Chefs Paul Rankin and Nick Nairn are in Lexington, Virginia to cook for descendants of the Ulster-Scots Lewis family who settled in the area in the 18th century. programme.desc: Actor and director Jordan Spiro (Ozark, Night Comes On) spent childhood vacations with her family in New Orleans. programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: The Falls: Testament Of Love
programme.desc: The Falls: Testament of Love is a continuation of the story of RJ Smith and Chris Merrill, two Mormon missionaries that fell in love during their mission in a small town in Oregon. The boys haven't spoken in five years, but when an unexpected tragedy compells them back to the Oregon town where they served, they find themselves, once again, thrust into one another's lives. As old feelings begin to surface they find themselves again facing difficult choices. If they pursue their desire to be together, RJ and Chris risk hurting the ones they care about as they embark on a spiritual journey to discover love, freedom, and happiness.

programme.title: Pique-Assiette

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Dans cette partie de la Bresse située en Saône-et-Loire, Jean-Thomas Vuillard est pisciculteur ; Alexandre Cauchy, producteur de piment et maraîcher. À découvrir en compagnie d'Aurélien Poirel : les espèces de la réserve naturelle nationale de Truchère-Ratenelle. Atelier plumes avec Estelle Petiot, à l'écomusée de la Bresse bourguignonne."

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Entre Haute-Loire et Ardèche, les grands espaces du Mézenc se découvrent avec Valérie Courbon, productrice de fruits rouges, et Florian Gibaud, éleveur. Sortie marmottes avec Alexandre Aubry, accompagnateur en montagne ; sensibilisation des randonneurs à la préservation du mont Mézenc avec Sébastien Michel, médiateur et guide nature."

programme.title: Donner l'gout
programme.desc: À la rencontre de Mitch et Boom, le duo à la tête de La Belle Tonki, un restaurant vietnamien de Montréal. Hélène découvre aussi Anh, la mère de Mitch, qui lui confie les secrets d'une bonne soupe phó.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S07

programme.title: Les Ambassadeurs 2025
programme.sub-title: Jodoigne et ses plus beaux villages
programme.desc: Cette année, le réseau des plus beaux villages de Wallonie souffle ses 30 bougies ! L'émission s'installe à Jodoigne, où Saint-Remy-Geest et Mélin ont tous deux reçu le label. Également : Totemus à Saint-Remy-Geest ; la ferme de Benoît Custine à la Roche-en-Ardenne ; l'univers des Baladins du miroir.

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo fusionne la taktouka marocaine et la chakchouka algérienne pour un plat unique. Poivrons rôtis, tomates juteuses, oeufs coulants... À déguster sans modération !

programme.sub-title: Veloute de lentilles, beignets de cuisses de grenouilles
programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Guy Martin présente les produits emblématiques du terroir français et propose une recette pour les accommoder.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08

programme.title: Donner l'gout

programme.title: La Recette de Guy Martin S08

programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Guy Martin présente les produits emblématiques du terroir français et propose une recette pour les accommoder.

programme.title: Donner l'gout

programme.title: Les Ambassadeurs 2025

programme.title: Novios Por Navidad
programme.desc: VALERIA siempre soñó con una boda navideña. Y cuando se hizo planificadora de eventos, eso se convirtió en su sello. Cuando decidió casarse con BERNARDO planificó su boda para Diciembre. Pero no contaba con que TERE, su mejor amiga, terminaría robándole el novio y la idea. Tere le pide a Valeria que organicé su boda para navidad. Valeria acepta y decide presentarse a la boda del brazo del novio perfecto. Pero para ello necesita conseguir un novio con urgencia. Y no se le ocurre mejor idea que pedirle a CAMILO, el dueño de la finca colonial que han alquilado para la boda, que se haga pasar por su novio. Valeria y Camilo son polos opuestos, pero la magia de la navidad hace lo suyo y la mentira termina convirtiéndose en un inesperado romance.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.sub-title: Isabelle Carre, Basile Alaoui, Roxane Mbanga
programme.desc: She is an actress who touches the heart. A César, two Molières and almost seventy films in a career spanning thirty-five years, Isabelle Carré is releasing "Les Rêveurs", her first film as a director, and it's big news! An 11-year-old prodigy, Basile Alaoui publishes his drawings on social networks and has already been noticed by the experts at "La Grande Galerie Francophone". When do you become an artist? How do you spot precocious talent? Here are some answers. Roxane Mbanga also takes a look at the place of black women in contemporary art. Finally, Alex Vizorek draws a portrait of the American painter John Singer Sargent.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S09
programme.sub-title: Special programme: around and about in Lausanne
programme.desc: We explore the canton's fine arts museum and its collections. Michelin-starred chef Franck Giovannini unpacks his bags in Crissier, in the canton of Vaud. With Viktor & Rolf, dresses and acres of tulle are turning heads. We meet Alexandre and Martino, founders of Swiss Koo.

programme.title: Démo de Mode
programme.desc: For autumn-winter 2023-2024, the Barbara Bui collection is presented in the form of small, slow motion clips. Tailoring, a pop-rock spirit and nonconformism await us.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S09
programme.desc: La Galerie Dior retraces the story of the famous French haute couture house, a tribute to the genius of Christian Dior and his successors. All about French lawyers' robes. L'Ingénieur Chevallier, the oldest French opticians, takes over Maison Bonnet, flagship of luxury eyewear. Wearing a bra as a top.

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S09
programme.desc: Legendary and highly recommended: L'Éclaireur, the concept store by Armand Hadida. All about the origins of the carat, the unit of measurement that governs the jewellery industry. Anicet: starting from what already exists and offering a new life to jewellery. Shorts and skirts: the elegant way to wear ultra-short hemlines.

programme.title: Chic en VF
programme.desc: The New National Museum of Monaco offers a showcase for contemporary art. Sommelier Patrice Frank recounts the story of a cellar unlike any other.

programme.title: LA BELLE VIE S03
programme.desc: Julien meets Joanie and Hugues, two former members of the armed forces, just a few days be-fore they set sail for the southern seas. Aboard their catamaran, they plan to spend five years seeking out the finest kitesurfing spots around the globe.

programme.title: Démo de Mode
programme.desc: Lyn Abdel Rahman presents Le Fil Paris, the brand she founded with Filza Marri, featuring a responsible philosophy focused on human beings and zero waste and with an initial fashion show in tribute to Lebanon and Pakistan.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Between craftwork and tradition, we visit the Basque and History of Bayonne Museum. The mosaic artist Anne-Cécile Lopez reinterprets an age-old art, at the crossroads between archaeology, geology and anthropology. Marc Jacobs' anniversary show offers a contemporary view of the domestic world. Charlotte Franier restores old paintings.

programme.title: HABITANTS DU NORD
programme.desc: Last adventures in Tombstone Territorial Park: the duo decides to do some canoeing and a guided mountain hike. Halfway through the hike, Nadia has to give up but Vincent makes it to the summit.

Meeting the leatherworkers: Valentine Huyghues Despointes and the craftsmen and women of Atelier Tassin. Milliners, cabinetmakers, fan-makers: Anthony Peto, Alain Taral, the Duvelleroy company.

programme.title: Chic en VF
programme.desc: The Cherqui Foundation, a collection of optical and cinematic artworks. Encounter with Jean-Guillaume Mathiaut, an artist whose work never fails to enchant, and his passion for architecture and cabinet-making.

programme.sub-title: A life of simplicity in the Acadian forest

programme.desc: One of the most Parisian and unusual designers discusses her spring-summer 2023 haute couture collection. The focus is firmly on the versatility of the garments, the work on the bias and sequins...

programme.title: HABITANTS DU NORD
programme.desc: At kilometer 371 of Dempster Highway, Nadia and Vincent treat themselves to some creature comforts at the Eagle Plains hotel. They make the acquaintance of Steve, a truck driver and philosopher. Finally, they meet up with Jesse for a bike ride of 34 kilometers.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Avenue Marceau, Paris, the Yves Saint Laurent Museum is dedicated to the great French fashion designer. Chef Philip Chronopoulos officiates beneath the arcades of the Palais Royal. Jean Paul Gaultier invites Simone Rocha to bring a new look to the fashion house's archives. Featherworker Valérie Tanfin makes nature sublime.

programme.desc: Hundreds of thousands of albums sold, a Cat who has been making us laugh and think for over forty years... The Belgian star of the comic strip is also an art enthusiast, and Philippe Geluck is our guest. Originally from Togo, this incredibly gifted artist made the headlines at the "As Known as Africa" fair in Paris, and has established herself as one of the leading figures in contemporary art. Atsoupé is with us. Finally, Alex Vizorek casts his expert eye over the paintings of Philip Guston.

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S09
programme.desc: The Lenôtre cookery school, passing on the passion for the culinary arts that drove its founder, the illustrious Gaston Lenôtre. programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: The Philharmonie de Paris is home to a museum dedicated to music. Vincent Garnier Pressiat's audacious fashion style permeates the French capital. Fashion designer Thom Browne recounts stories inspired by Edgar Allan Poe. The meticulous and delicate art of ceramist Yuko Kuramatsu, adept of the technique of neriage.

programme.title: Démo de Mode
programme.desc: As a tribute to Maria Callas, filmed by Claude Lelouch at the Opera, Stéphane Rolland's show recreates the atmosphere of a 1950s gala evening. An autumn-winter 2023-2024 haute couture collection which focuses on the graphical aspects, the structure and black and white.

programme.title: Hunting and Nature Museum
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!
